features.name: Themeable layouts
features.description: New feature in 2024 Release Wave 2 that allows layouts for reports like sales quotes, confirmations, and invoices to be responsive to Office themes without developer involvement.

features.name: Abts font in Office
features.description: New font in Office that is available in Business Central Online as of December 2024.

features.name: Word layout watermark support
features.description: Ability to add custom watermarks to Word layouts for reports, including picture watermarks for themed designs.

features.name: Seasonal layout switching
features.description: Ability to set different themed layouts as default for different seasons or periods and switch between them.
